# Blackline Couriers LLC

> Same-day courier based in Meriden, Connecticut. Dedicated cargo van for time-sensitive parcels, documents, parts, and freight. HIPAA and bloodborne-pathogen certified driver. $1M auto liability and $100K cargo insurance. USDOT 8134132, MC75312942.

- Phone: (203) 751-3046
- Email: dispatch@blacklinecouriers.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday 6:00 AM-6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Service area: Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, and New England (standard same-day reach within a 250-mile radius of Meriden, CT)
- Pricing: flat, distance-based, quoted up front, with the return to base included. Rate quotes on request.
